content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Let’s start with the conventional options. Platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity but operate on rented infrastructure. They handle hosting, payment processing, and delivery—until they don’t. Each platform has its own restrictions, and all of them rely on Stripe or PayPal for payments. If those gateways fail or exclude your country, your business stops. Crypto payment processors like Coinbase Commerce or BitPay offer an alternative but still require you to integrate them into your own infrastructure. They handle payments but leave hosting, delivery, and automation to you. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack takes a different approach. It’s a complete, sovereign commerce infrastructure deployed directly to your GitHub or Cloudflare account. You own the hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer architecture designed to bypass platform dependencies entirely.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad and Paddle exclude Nigeria and other regions outright due to their reliance on Stripe and PayPal. Even if they offer crypto payments, the underlying infrastructure still depends on centralized gateways. Coinbase Commerce and BitPay are more accessible but still require you to build and host your own storefront. They’re tools, not complete solutions. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is built specifically for creators in restricted regions. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which has no country restrictions. This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where payment rejection and currency collapse are realities. It’s not just an alternative—it’s a structural solution designed to operate where conventional platforms fail.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle charge 8-10% per transaction, plus payment processing fees. Crypto processors like Coinbase Commerce and BitPay charge 1-2% but require you to handle hosting and delivery. NOWPayments, used in COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, charges a flat 0.5% fee with no additional costs. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, and the webhook triggers instant product delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost difference isn’t just in fees—it’s in ownership. With COREMERCH, you pay a one-time $197 deployment fee for the Edge Commerce Stack. After that, the infrastructure is yours. No subscriptions. No platform cuts. No dependency on third-party gateways. Compare that to renting infrastructure indefinitely from platforms that can shut you down at any time.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Gumroad and Paddle own your customer data, payment history, and product delivery. If they shut down or change their terms, you lose access. Crypto processors like Coinbase Commerce and BitPay give you more control over payments but require you to build and maintain your own infrastructure. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack gives you full ownership from day one. The stack is deployed to your GitHub or Cloudflare account, and you control every component. Orders are stored in your Supabase database, files are delivered from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and payments are verified via NOWPayments. Automation is handled via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring instant product delivery without manual intervention. This isn’t just ownership—it’s infrastructure sovereignty. You’re not renting; you’re building on a foundation you control.
